judul: 5 prompt Claude Artifacts untuk nota prasekolah
hook: 5 prompt Claude Artifacts yang cikgu prasekolah patut simpan untuk buat nota ringkas dalam beberapa minit.
posts:
5 prompt Claude Artifacts yang cikgu prasekolah patut simpan untuk buat nota ringkas dalam beberapa minit.

Simpan terus, senang bila perlu.

Ini senarainya:

1. Nota tema harian

“Create a single-file HTML one-page lesson note for preschool children on [topic]. Include 3 short sentences, 5 picture words and one simple activity. Large font, Malay language.”

Tampal, tunggu siap, tekan Preview.

2. Nota huruf dan bunyi

“Create a one-page printable note for 5 year old children on the letter [letter]. Show 5 example words, a tracing line and a short Malay rhyme.”

3. Nota cerita pendek

“Create a one-page note summarising this story for 4 to 6 year olds in 6 short lines, with one question after each line.”

4. Nota nombor 1 hingga 10

“Create a one-page counting note from 1 to 10 with count dots, number words and one simple action per number.”

Kalau hasil tak kemas, minta AI betulkan saiz huruf.

Selamat mencuba.
